headline: US Strikes Iranian Missile Launcher on Qeshm After Iranian Launches
subheadline: US Air Force struck a missile launcher on Qeshm Island after Iran launched missiles from the area, according to CENTCOM officials.
lede: US Air Force and self-defense strikes hit Iranian missile launchers on Qeshm Island and southern coastal sites after Iranian missile launches, while Houthi missiles triggered sirens across Saudi Arabia and explosions hit Tabriz and Jask. Iran signaled it will not escalate further before the US implements seven demands conveyed via Vice President Vance's letter. An Israeli soldier was charged with spying for Iran, transferring military base data and photos of US assets.

sections.title: Russian Strikes Hit Ukrainian Cities Amid Drone Attacks
sections.body: Russian drone and missile strikes hit Kyiv, Dnipro, and Chernihiv, causing significant civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. A Russian drone struck a train station in Dnipro, killing 13 civilians and injuring 13 others. Ukraine claimed destruction of two Russian Su-34 fighters and an Iskander launcher. Over 350,000 consumers lost power in Dnipro after a drone attack on energy infrastructure.

sections.title: US Strikes Iranian Launchers After Iranian Missile Launches
sections.body: US forces struck Iranian missile launchers on Qeshm Island and southern coastal sites following Iranian missile launches. Houthi missiles triggered sirens across Saudi Arabia and multiple explosions occurred in Iranian cities including Tabriz and Jask. Iran signaled it will not escalate further before the US implements seven demands conveyed via Vice President Vance's letter. An Israeli soldier was charged with spying for Iran, transferring military base data and photos of US assets.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Direct kinetic exchange between US and Iranian forces has occurred, while Iran's conditional restraint pending US implementation of seven demands indicates calibrated escalation management. Israeli counterintelligence failure with a soldier recruited by Iranian intelligence for over a year, providing data on US assets, reveals significant penetration. US force posture changes signal preparation for wider conflict.
